name: Fist Strike VR
summary: Put on your headset and box to the music. Fist Strike VR is a single-player rhythm boxing fitness game for Meta Quest. Punch incoming beat targets with straights, hooks, and combinations. Block, duck, and dodge left or right as music, sound effects, and controller haptics drive each session. Choose from 32 replayable workouts grouped into four BPM-based tempo levels. Sessions last about 6 to 54 minutes; choose a difficulty and duration that fit your time and fitness level. All built-in workouts are included
